# REDTEAM #168 (SPEC Sec 19.2, T-301.2): without hardware address tagging,
# loads MUST test the color and unmask to the canonical address, and every
# syscall and cgo entry MUST untag pointers. This script invokes the
# software-unmask and untag unit gates. Page-registering tests need a
# zgc-linked test binary: the page registry initializes from zgcInit, which
# runs only when the linker selects zgc mode (src/runtime/logos_gcmode.go),
# so experiment-only execution fatals before any gate runs. The phase gates
# stay closed, so the row stays planned (parent owns the ledger).
[!GOARCH:amd64] [!GOARCH:arm64] skip 'GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving software unmasking needs amd64 or arm64'
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=logosgcmoving
go test -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=zgc -count=1 -run 'TestLogosZgcUnmaskWord|TestLogosZgcUntagArgForeign|TestLogosZgcUntagArgColoredHeap|TestLogosZgcScanWordForeign|TestLogosZgcSyscallUntag|TestLogosZgcSoftwareBarrier' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcUnmaskWord'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcUntagArgForeign'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcUntagArgColoredHeap'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcScanWordForeign'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcSyscallUntag'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcSoftwareBarrier'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'
go test -race -v -ldflags=-X=runtime.logosGCMode=zgc -count=1 -run 'TestLogosZgcUnmaskWord|TestLogosZgcUntagArgForeign|TestLogosZgcUntagArgColoredHeap|TestLogosZgcScanWordForeign|TestLogosZgcSyscallUntag|TestLogosZgcSoftwareBarrier' runtime
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcUnmaskWord'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcUntagArgForeign'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcUntagArgColoredHeap'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcScanWordForeign'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcSyscallUntag'
stdout '--- PASS: TestLogosZgcSoftwareBarrier'
stdout '^ok\s+runtime'
! stderr 'no tests to run'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/redteam168

go 1.27
